Meta SAM mask decoder
---------------------
Assets/Scripts/Windups/MetaSam.cs contains a C# port of the `one_bit` mask decoder of Meta's
`@meta-sam/parser` 0.1.0 (npm; dist/mask-codec.js: unpack, RangeDecoder, decodeRaster),
Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.

It is used under the SAM License (LICENSE.txt in this folder), which must stay with any copy of it.
Source: https://github.com/meta-models/meta-sam (typescript/packages/parser). Ported 2026-11-14 (F83).
